verdict.rationale: Docs describe Logfire tracing as 'built-in but optional' — telemetry/tracing is only sent if you explicitly install and configure the Logfire package and enable instrumentation, implying no tracking occurs by default without opt-in. However, there is no explicit 'opt-out' toggle or privacy statement addressing a default-on telemetry/usage-tracking system to disable. Missing for 10: explicit opt-out mechanism or setting, independent confirmation that no background usage data is collected by pydantic-ai itself, and clarity on any anonymous usage stats beyond Logfire.
